g.text: Ten culture levels; three acquisitions per level. Fixed extract-calibration coefficients and session-medium blank.

g.text: Error bars show acquisition SD only. Equivalents are not independently validated culture concentrations.

g.text: Shading indicates estimates below the lowest positive calibration reference, not a detection limit.
